tbesh_html:
Ashtoreth-karnaim = "Ashtoreth of the two horns or peaks"
a city in Bashan east of the Jordan given to Manasseh
Also named: qar.na.im (קַרְנַ֫יִם "Karnaim" H7161B)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Ashteroth-Karnaim, a place East of the Jordan
strongs_1890.derivation: from H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת) and the dual of H7161 (קֶרֶן); Ashtaroth of (the) double horns (a symbol of the deity);
